Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.vNck1Oor9udzoSRj]{Storm Surge Stance}

Your aerial control grants you greater movements. While in your stance, you can move 5 feet further or 3 feet higher when you Leap. You do not trigger reactions when you move through the air or land as part of a Leap (though you trigger reactions normally when you begin the Leap).

While in the stance, if you have the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.8ad23sFdfBpqwklz]{Aspect of Skies}, at any point after a Leap before you touch the ground, you can take a second action to Leap again as your motes propel you further with stormy winds. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.pid3Nv3o23ilx3n6]{Aspect of Tides}, as you fall, your motes instead automatically form a bed of water to dampen your fall as if you intentionally dove in to a 30 foot deep pool of water; you can use a reaction to similarly direct your motes on a falling creature within 60 feet of you to grant them this benefit.
